title: Karl Blossfeldt's Plant Photographs
content: Karl Blossfeldt’s photographs of plants inspired a generation of designers.He began as a sculptor, working in an iron foundry.He wasn't trained as a photographer. He made his photos of plants with a home-made camera that was able to magnify leaves and buds, revealing symmetry and order in an apparently objective manner.He became a professor of applied arts, and his photos were used mainly as teaching tools.At age 63, he became a success overnight when his photos were published asUrformen der Kunst(sometimes translated as Art Forms in The Plant World), which is still in print.-----Public Domain ReviewWikipedia on Karl Blossfeldt
